statement.zh: **人物**：松井充（Mitsuru Matsui）。本行是人物行，其原理对应贡献而非算法叙述。论文标题印为「The First Experimental Cryptanalysis of the Data Encryption Standard」，作者印为「Mitsuru Matsui」；摘要又印出「This paper describes an improved version of linear cryptanalysis and its application to the first successful computer experiment in breaking the full 16-round DES.」。因此该条目把松井充定位为线性密码分析的改进者与首次完整 16 轮 DES 计算机实验的实施者，不把 DES 的设计归给他。
statement.en: **Person**: Mitsuru Matsui.It is registered under cryptanalysis.

statement.zh: 方法由论文自己印出：「The scenario is a known-plaintext attack based on two new linear approximate equations, each of which provides candidates for 13 secret key bits with negligible memory.」。因此该条目只说该攻击以两个新的线性近似方程为基础、每个方程以可忽略内存给出 13 个密钥位的候选，不把它扩写成对所有分组密码的通用攻击。
statement.en: It is listed because it connects concrete records, objects or procedures in cryptanalysis, not because of its name.

statement.zh: 用途与输入条件由摘要限定为已知明文场景，并印出「if 2 4.3  random plaintexts and their ciphertexts are available.」。因此该条目只说该实验需要大量随机明文及其密文，不声称它适用于选择明文、选择密文或只有单个已知明文的场景。
statement.en: Fix the object and its aliases; list the sourced dates, roles, parameters or inscriptions; state the observable output; then test the boundary.Any step without a source stops there rather than being filled with prose.

statement.zh: 边界与代价由论文印出：「the full 16-round DES is breakable with high success probability」，且作者「he finally reached all of the 56 secret key bits in fifty days」，其中「out of which forty days were spent for generating plaintexts and their ciphertexts and only ten days were spent for the actual key search」。因此该条目所称的破限定为完整 16 轮 DES 的密钥恢复实验，不称所有 DES 变体或所有密钥长度同时被破。
statement.en: The boundary separates a sourced fact, a model-derived relation and an unverified gap.Secondary summaries yield to primary material; unsourced dates, counts and device values stay blank.
